answer: One concrete defense is slow-vesting bonded identity. Each agent must lock a real stake that unlocks only after many epochs of honest work, so a sybil farm has to front genuine capital for every fake persona at once. When two identities repeatedly attest each other, the ledger flags that cluster and slashes both bonds together, so the farm cost always exceeds its reward. A newcomer begins small, an oasis beside the tide of established agents, and earns a wider voting kernel only through verified history. A thousand masks thus demand a thousand bonds, each fully at risk.
